summary: HUTCHMED filed a routine Form 6-K disclosing a press release that regulatory submissions for ORPATHYS (savolitinib) plus TAGRISSO (osimertinib) were accepted for review by the EMA in Europe and by Japan's MHLW, following a September 2026 US FDA NDA submission. The filings rest on SAFFRON Phase III data showing PFS HR 0.55 and OS HR 0.68 versus platinum chemotherapy. No transaction, ownership stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is present; this is ordinary clinical-regulatory disclosure rather than a special situation.
